notes:
Apex 2.0.0.0

- Guild Fest card in Settings > Events, after the engine's own screen: live status (attempts, guild and personal score, the taken quest), Refresh, Cancel current quest (confirm only; it costs an attempt).
- Guild Fest mission tables: tick Solo 120% / Solo 200% / Guild task per mission, Tick all / Untick all, Change all limits, and an Automated column from the engine's own template.
- Guild Fest saves write into the account file from the engine's own template defaults; a save that changes nothing says so instead of "Saved".
- Item to buy with guild coins, read from the game's own shop table.
